aspect: There is frequently no line to join
description: For a Mexican adult with no close US-citizen relative and no employer petition, no queue exists at all. 'Getting in line' describes a line that was never built for him.
energy_note: Told to wait in a queue that does not exist.

aspect: Taxes paid into systems that will never pay out
description: Work under an ITIN or a borrowed number contributes to Social Security and Medicare against a record he can never claim.
energy_note: Paying into a pension belonging to nobody.

description: A traffic stop, a hospital admission, a dispute with a landlord or a wage complaint all carry a second consequence nobody else faces, which is why they go unreported.
energy_note: He cannot afford to be the victim of a crime.

aspect: The decade produces roots and no status
description: Fifteen years produces a mortgage, a business, school runs and citizen children - and not one day of lawful presence. Time accrues equity everywhere except in the file.
energy_note: Fifteen years of life, and zero days of status.

description: He keeps them in a shoebox: fourteen years of tax documents under a number that is not his. His lawyer says they prove good moral character and continuous presence. They also prove fourteen years of using a false number. The same box is the evidence both ways.
energy_note: The same shoebox is his defence and his confession.
